surface_69.shape: 68 are zero-argument `X_new()` constructors whose only unsafe act is ASN1_item_new on a crate-owned static item; 1 (SCT_new) zallocs one Sct and writes two integer fields

rows.reaches: OwnedCtx::<Sct>::zalloc_at then two unsafe integer field writes through sct.as_ptr(); into_raw transfers the block
rows.precondition_basis: established in code: zalloc_at returns a fresh zeroed block of exactly size_of::<Sct>() at CRYPTO_zalloc's alignment (align > SEAM_MALLOC_ALIGN refused); all-zero Sct is a valid bit pattern (c_int/u8/u64/usize/nullable raw pointers); into_raw consumes the owner so Drop cannot free twice
rows.why_not_a_hole: no caller-supplied memory: zero parameters (or, for SCT_new, none either); the only raw pointer is the crate-owned static item or the fresh allocation this frame made; exclusivity is not assumed from a caller; a safe caller can only receive an unowned raw pointer, whose use needs an unsafe block
